title: Recall a multi-step onboarding workflow in order

origin.notes: Original synthetic case; no adaptation. Held-out: excluded from the development loop.

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Host: odin (router). Tool: hlabctl. All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Remember the router onboarding steps: first flash firmware 3.2, then set the LAN subnet to 10.20.0.0/24, then register it in hlabctl with the edge tag.
setup.note: The full procedure, three ordered steps.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Unrelated: the garage camera's motion feed goes to the edge box.

probe.text: How do I onboard a new router in the lab?

expected.correct: flash firmware 3.2, set LAN subnet to 10.20.0.0/24, register in hlabctl with the edge tag
acceptable_variants: 1) flash firmware 3.2, 2) LAN subnet 10.20.0.0/24, 3) hlabctl register with edge tag
flash 3.2, configure subnet, register via hlabctl edge tag
